findings.certainty: supported by static control flow; no real helper executed
findings.description: Push-PR creates the remote branch and PR before attempting exclusive creation of pr-created.json. Archive populates the ignored main archive before attempting exclusive creation of archive-receipt.json. A pre-existing final receipt path can therefore cause failure after externally visible or local archival effects. Existing path refusal prevents receipt overwrite but is too late to prevent those effects.
findings.recommended_fix: Reserve each output receipt with open(x) before the first mutation, retain a try/finally terminal receipt through that already-owned handle, and preserve existing files. For push-PR include explicit repo/source identity checks in later binding review.
findings.acceptance: Isolated stub test with occupied receipt must fail without reaching any push/PR creation or archive-write operation; empty receipt path still permits controlled success/failure receipt writing. No real Git/GitHub mutation for regression.
